findings: The headline as printed (l.2363) is supported only in DEC-28's Cauchy-compact form (Barbot's equality needs absolute maximality, B21 Cor 2.18); with DEC-107 the form of record is btz_uniformization_C1, whose only sorryAx comes through cor_abs_max_C1 (the (G0) smoothing is no longer on the path).

The display l.2369 is wrong (D-12 (c)); certified: D(Reg M~) = Omega+(Lambda) = bigcap_w I+(Pi_w) with equality, plus, on M itself, a full future BTZ ray from every BTZ point (E0Spear.exists_fullFutureBTZRay_e0, B21 Lemma 2.3) — the M-side of 'future complete lightlike rays Delta_i'.

DEC-76's 'non-abelian' suffices once pi1(Reg M) is known free: a non-abelian free group is not metabelian (GX.not_isMetabelianGroup_of_isFreeGroup, 0 sorry: two distinct generators map onto F_2, where [[a,b],[a,b^-1]] != 1 is decided by reduction; a free group on <= 1 generator is commutative). The remaining gap to DEC-76's literal hypothesis is purely the geometric fact 'pi1(Reg M) is free' (Reg M ~ (Sigma minus sing) x R, s >= 1, the surface classification), carried as IsFreeGroup.

The theorem's 'M~' with BTZ topology: under DEC-106 T_BTZ enters only the final homeomorphism M = rho\D(M~), which is the unformalized BTZ half; the injectivity step on M~ (l.2392-2394) is proved with the chart-generated << of (M~, T') (IsBTZFutureComplete), the natural-topology literal reading being refuted in GX.BTZ.Manifolds (not_isFutureComplete_natCausality).
questions: Bridge (WP-43f's question, still open): the BTZ half (D on sing M~, Delta_i in the boundary of Omega, M = rho\D(M~) with T_BTZ) needs a SingularGXStructure built from the ChartedSpace E0Y / e0Groupoid atlas, an identification reg M~ ≃ₜ UniversalCover (e0RegMFlat M) x0 compatible with the developing maps, and then the limit construction of D at BTZ points. Not built in WP-44g (a package of its own: the presentations live in different universes/instance stacks — BTZTildeData over SingularGXStructure (Isom M^3) M^3 M, MaxBranchedCover — versus ChartedSpace E0Y M). Should a dedicated package build it, or is the headline accepted on Reg M + full future BTZ rays of M?

DEC-76 reading: accept (a) 'pi1(Reg M) not metabelian', or (b) 'pi1(Reg M) free and non-abelian' (btz_uniformization_C1_of_isFreeGroup, which is now literally DEC-76 plus freeness), or (c) require freeness to be proved (surface classification of a Cauchy surface of Reg M, not available)?

Three unbuilt pieces: (i) {tau = -1} is a Cauchy surface of {tau<0} — needs tau - 1/tau to be a Cauchy time function, i.e. tau -> 0- along future-inextensible and -> -inf along past-inextensible causal curves of {tau<0} (a confinement argument like E0.futureExtensible_sliceDom on the unbounded domain, including convergence of the angular part); (ii) the developed slice btzPaperDev({-1} x (0,inf) x R) is a spacelike Lipschitz graph in every flat chart of Reg {tau<0} (Causal.Flat.IsSpacelikeLipschitzIn); (iii) the length metric of e0SliceSys on the slice equals the Euclidean metric of C in the coordinate x.2 (density |z'| at regular times from btzPaperDev's pullback dr^2 + r^2 dtheta^2, 0 at the BTZ time; lower bound by FTC on the regular intervals with z = 0 at BTZ times, upper bound by straight segments, which needs the derivative of the local angle lift E0.angle), hence complete with continuous identity.

findings: As printed the proposition is false (D-11, DEC-77). Counterexample {tau<0} ⊂ E0: GH, BTZ points, no developing pair of Reg {tau<0} future complete (GX.e0PastHalf_counterexample, 0 sorry). Its Cauchy-completeness (DEC-31) is now STATED with a Lean predicate, GX.IsE0CauchyComplete (Cauchy surface S, Causal.Flat.IsSpacelikeLipschitz of S ∩ Reg in Reg M's flat charts, CompleteSpace of the length space of GX.e0SliceSys S — flat charts at regular points, constant at BTZ points, so a BTZ time contributes no length — and continuity of the identity to M); the full counterexample with the printed hypothesis is GX.e0PastHalf_counterexample_DEC31, resting on GX.e0PastHalf_isE0CauchyComplete (tagged sorry).

Under DEC-106 the conclusion 'M future complete' (def:manifold_future_complete_all, x in M~) cannot hold literally once sing M != ∅ (natCausality has I+ = ∅ at BTZ points, WP-44c); the certified content is the proof's two steps: Reg M~ future complete and full future BTZ rays (B21 Lemma 2.3, which the proof cites as 'Lemma 2.4', D-11 (b)).
The proof's l.2350 omits that Barbot's future completeness needs equality D(reg M~) = Omega+, i.e. absolute maximality (B21 Cor 2.18) and the future case.
questions: Is DEC-31's predicate as formalized (GX.IsE0CauchyComplete: the length structure across the BTZ lines given by a chart system constant at BTZ points, i.e. a curve's length = the integral of its regular densities) the intended reading of 'the length structure extended across the singular lines'?
